demonstrates: Flat vector illustration on a photographic base model. Our measured rule says Qwen cannot leave photography by prompt - this is the cleanest test of that rule in the whole set.
substitution: Qwen-Image 2512 for the base arm because the set routes it there; ALSO rendered on the real Z-Image Turbo in --mode zimage. Both arms exist, compare them.
